runtime.launcher: uv run --offline --with pandas --with numpy --with pyarrow --with scikit-learn python

commands.capture_forecast: uv run --offline --with pandas --with numpy --with pyarrow --with scikit-learn python capture_prospective_tradingview_consensus.py capture --days-ahead 60
commands.capture_actual: uv run --offline --with pandas --with numpy --with pyarrow --with scikit-learn python capture_prospective_tradingview_actuals.py capture
commands.prewarm_ownership: uv run --offline --with pandas --with numpy --with pyarrow --with scikit-learn python prewarm_prospective_neutral_ownership.py capture --eligible-date {date} --max-new-requests 120
commands.capture_ownership: uv run --offline --with pandas --with numpy --with pyarrow --with scikit-learn python capture_prospective_neutral_ownership.py capture --eligible-date {date}
commands.capture_event_market: uv run --offline --with pandas --with numpy --with pyarrow --with scikit-learn python capture_prospective_dukascopy_event_m5.py capture --event-time {event_time}
commands.process_campaign: uv run --offline --with pandas --with numpy --with pyarrow --with scikit-learn python run_prospective_neutral_campaign_v1.py process --as-of {as_of}
commands.capture_path: uv run --offline --with pandas --with numpy --with pyarrow --with scikit-learn python capture_prospective_eurusd_trade_path.py capture --signal-id {signal_id} --entry-time {entry_time}
commands.capture_oracle: uv run --offline --with pandas --with numpy --with pyarrow --with scikit-learn python capture_prospective_neutral_oracle_day.py capture --oracle-date {date}
